harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: Deployed PostgreSQL 9.5 streaming replication across node1 (initial primary), node2, and node3 (standbys) using pg_basebackup + recovery.conf. Demonstrated failover by stopping node1: promoted node2 to writable primary with zero data loss, repointed node3 to replicate from node2, then rebuilt node1 as a standby of node2 via fresh base backup. Final steady state: node2 = primary, node1 & node3 = streaming standbys, all data consistent. Completed the mandatory node-restart protocol on all three nodes one at a time (node1, node3, then node2-the-current-primary-last), each showing a changed boot_id/uptime and full replication/data recovery afterward, with quorum/write-availability preserved throughout (never restarting the sole writable primary until the topology no longer depended on the just-restarted nodes for availability).
actions_performed: Installed postgresql/postgresql-contrib (v9.5) via apt on node1, node2, node3
Configured node1 as primary: listen_addresses, wal_level=hot_standby, max_wal_senders, wal_keep_segments, pg_hba.conf replication entries for all 3 node IPs
Created 'replicator' replication role with a randomly generated password (generated on node1, passed via secret_env, never printed in final report)
Created repl_test table and inserted baseline rows on node1
Ran pg_basebackup -X stream from node1 onto node2 and node3, configured recovery.conf on each, started them as streaming standbys, verified pg_stat_replication and matching data
Simulated primary loss: inserted a pre-failover row, confirmed it replicated to node2, then stopped postgresql on node1
Promoted node2 with pg_ctl promote; verified pg_is_in_recovery=f, verified no data loss, wrote a post-failover row
Repointed node3's recovery.conf to stream from node2 (10.100.65.11); verified streaming state and full data consistency
Rebuilt node1 via fresh pg_basebackup from node2 (new timeline 2), configured recovery.conf pointing at node2, started as standby; verified replication and data consistency across all 3 nodes
Captured pre-restart boot_id/uptime and health/data baselines on all 3 nodes

Rebooted node1 (standby) via systemctl reboot backgrounded so ack returned before disconnect; polled until reachable; confirmed new boot_id, postgresql active, standby rejoined replication, data intact
Rebooted node3 (standby) the same way; confirmed new boot_id, recovered as standby, data intact, node2 shows it streaming

Rebooted node2 (primary) last, only after both standbys were healthy; confirmed new boot_id, came back as primary (not in recovery), accepted a new write, both standbys resumed streaming and replicated the new row

evidence.requirement: Streaming replication established: node1 primary, node2 & node3 standbys
evidence.summary: pg_stat_replication on node1 shows node2 and node3 streaming (async); repl_test table matches on both standbys

evidence.requirement: Failover: standby (node2) takes over as writable primary without losing committed data after primary loss
evidence.summary: Row inserted on node1 confirmed replicated to node2 before node1 was stopped; node2 promoted (pg_is_in_recovery=f) and retained all rows including the pre-failover row, plus accepted a new write

evidence.requirement: Third node (node3) repointed to new primary and stays consistent
evidence.summary: node3 recovery.conf updated to host=node2, restarted, confirmed streaming in pg_stat_replication on node2, and repl_test data matches

evidence.requirement: Recovered former primary (node1) rejoins as standby of current primary (node2) without data loss
evidence.summary: node1 wiped, fresh pg_basebackup taken from node2 (timeline 2), recovery.conf pointed at node2, restarted as standby; pg_stat_replication on node2 shows node1 streaming; a new row inserted on node2 appeared on both node1 and node3

evidence.requirement: node1 restart: healthy baseline, restart ack, changed boot identity, recovered state
evidence.summary: Baseline boot_id 88feca03...; reboot acknowledged before disconnect; post-restart boot_id 6f0dee12... (changed) with new uptime; postgresql active, standby rejoined replication to node2, data intact

evidence.requirement: node3 restart: healthy baseline, restart ack, changed boot identity, recovered state
evidence.summary: Baseline boot_id b185f188...; reboot acknowledged before disconnect; post-restart boot_id 49261ad5... (changed) with new uptime; postgresql active, standby rejoined replication to node2, data intact

evidence.requirement: node2 (primary) restart: healthy baseline, restart ack, changed boot identity, recovered state with quorum preserved
evidence.summary: Baseline boot_id 0d49f077...; restarted only after both standbys were confirmed healthy; reboot acknowledged before disconnect; post-restart boot_id 5d194b6b... (changed); came back as primary (not in recovery), accepted a new write, both standbys resumed streaming and replicated the new row to all nodes
